repositories.description: Gradio WebUI for creators and developers, featuring key TTS (Edge-TTS, kokoro) and zero-shot Voice Cloning (E2 & F5-TTS, CosyVoice), with Whisper audio processing, YouTube download, Demucs vocal isolation, and multilingual translation.
repositories.description_zh: 面向创作者和开发者的 Gradio WebUI，集成 TTS、zero-shot Voice Cloning、Whisper 音频处理、YouTube 下载、人声分离和多语言翻译。

repositories.description: Invidious is an alternative front-end to YouTube

repositories.description_zh: Microsoft 的 3D 生成项目，使用原生且紧凑的结构化 latent 表示来生成 3D 内容。

repositories.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
repositories.description_zh: 腾讯云 TencentDB Agent Memory 是团队级 AI Agent 记忆中心，可把对话、文档和代码转化为 Chat Memory、Skill、LLM-Wiki、Code-Graph 四类可复用记忆资产。

repositories.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
repositories.description_zh: 字节跳动开源的长任务 SuperAgent harness，结合 sandbox、记忆、工具、skills、subagents 和消息网关，可处理从数分钟到数小时的研究、编码及内容创作任务。
面向工作的多人 agent harness，用于组织多个 agent 协同执行任务。
